title: Measure: repeated encounters versus distinct objects (3.16, 3.17)
hints: The unit is one attempted request to the supplied fields function.
Which function argument does the strategy actually call?
Wrap that argument with a local counter and pass the wrapper to the strategy.

questions.prompt: On a stack of n pairs where each pair points twice to the one below, how many expansions does naive make?

choices.why: Doubling occurs at every level, not just once.
The recurrence C(n)=1+2*C(n-1), C(0)=0 gives this count.

checklist.step: Delegate the supplied function and count the calls actually made
Replay the changing measured count after each delegated expansion
